source.dataset: World Values Survey: Round Seven - Country-Pooled Datafile Version 6.0
source.license_note: WVS permits non-commercial research use with citation but prohibits redistribution of the original data files.

features.label: Age group
features.meaning: Age recoded into six WVS intervals.

features.label: Sex
features.meaning: Respondent sex category in the official WVS Wave 7 v6.0 CSV. The paper labels this field Q262, but Q262 is age in the official release; Q260 is the compatible sex field.

features.label: Number of children
features.meaning: Number of children reported by the respondent.

features.label: Education level
features.meaning: Highest educational level of the respondent under ISCED 2011.

features.label: Country-specific WVS region
features.meaning: Country-specific regional identifier. It is not a cross-country-comparable social attribute.

features.label: Importance of leisure time
features.meaning: How important leisure time is in the respondent's life.

features.label: Safe-shelter deprivation
features.meaning: Frequency in the last 12 months that the respondent or family went without safe shelter.

features.label: Generalized social trust
features.meaning: Whether most people can be trusted or one needs to be very careful.

features.label: Autonomy index
features.meaning: WVS four-item autonomy index from -2 to 2. Lower values emphasize obedience and religious faith; higher values emphasize determination, perseverance, and independence.

features.label: Inverse respect for authority
features.meaning: Welzel defiance component. Higher values indicate less respect for authority.

features.label: Inverse national pride
features.meaning: Welzel defiance component. Higher values indicate lower national pride.

features.label: Defiance
features.meaning: Welzel defiance sub-index. Higher values indicate stronger defiance.

features.label: Scepticism
features.meaning: Welzel scepticism index. Higher values indicate stronger scepticism.

features.label: Autonomy
features.meaning: Welzel emancipative-values autonomy sub-index. Higher values indicate stronger autonomy.

features.label: Equality
features.meaning: Welzel emancipative-values equality sub-index. Higher values indicate stronger equality orientation.

features.label: Inverse devoutness
features.meaning: Welzel defiance component. Higher values indicate lower religious devoutness.
